summary: Iteration 68 - Testing guided audio and install features. TopNav Install button PASS (visible on inner pages). GuidedPracticeOverlay UI elements PASS (timer, play/pause, mute, exit buttons working). CRITICAL ISSUE: Audio does NOT start within 25 seconds - users see 'Preparing your guide...' indefinitely. Root cause: AI script expansion times out (>25s) and TTS generation takes ~9s per segment. The fallback narration plan is set but TTS generation is slow.

critical.issue: AI script expansion with use_ai=true times out (>30 seconds). The 12-second timeout in LLM call is not being respected or the LLM is slow.

minor.issue: TTS generation takes ~9 seconds for longer text segments (100+ words). This is acceptable but contributes to overall delay.

integration_issues.issue: Audio does NOT start within 25 seconds. The 'Preparing your guide...' status shows indefinitely. Users perceive this as 'no audible guidance' since script text is visible but audio never starts.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix AI script expansion timeout - either reduce LLM timeout or disable AI expansion by default
Consider starting TTS generation with fallback narration immediately while AI expansion runs in background
The FIRST_SEGMENT_TARGET_WORDS=90 change should help but TTS still takes ~9s for 90 words
Consider pre-generating first segment TTS before showing overlay
Add clearer progress indicator showing 'Audio will start in X seconds'

content.py line 428: LLM timeout is 12 seconds but actual call takes 30+ seconds - timeout not working
The fallback narration plan is set (line 412-413) but TTS generation still takes 9+ seconds per segment
